body.message:
I honestly don't have time for this. It's becoming a hassle to deal with, and it's making me reconsider continuing with you. I'll only extend for this month.

The way you've been speaking to us since last week has created unnecessary drama over something that has never been an issue before. We've always paid 1–2 days before the renewal date, and we've never missed a payment. We're simply waiting to receive funds, and we can complete the payment within two days.

If your concern is securing the booking, we can pay AED 1,000 now as a confirmation, and we've already paid a security deposit as well.

This has become far more complicated than it needs to be.
